reader_summary:
我先在11.10把圖片位置的數量當作序列預算來算，知道切得更細會多花空間，卻還不能推成更準。11.11接著讓同一批顏色／形狀成績拆開，因此我知道總分背後可能藏著沒學會的題型。11.12明確換成讀字：紅色圓形和數字筆畫不是同一個能力；小字形先讓標籤和像素有可見對應，再回到較大的數字OCR實驗。11.13沿著那批錯字改問整串是否抄對、是否少字或多字，而不是只看單個位置。

11.14把任務拉回整張照片，開頭的人、杯子、桌子讓我立刻知道這次要說動作與關係。這是換題，不是前一個數字模型已經學會照片描述。讀過所指的問答與切塊段落後，紅藍交換仍有同樣平均的例子就接得上：物件有哪些，不等於位置與關係還在。11.15沿著輸入先丟掉資訊這件事，用同樣的平均方式把細筆畫變淡；未／末的開頭交代為什麼中文字值得這樣檢查。它再把已訓練底座、圖片處理器與微調分別介紹成第20章的後續實用工作，沒有要我現在下載或跑大模型。11.16從能看見筆畫再前進到順序與評分：兩行告示即使所有字都出現，也可能讀錯；臺／台則讓我把逐字抄寫和事先約定的統一規則分清。

到第12章，開頭直接說聲音也需要特徵，但原始輸入換成沿時間記錄的振幅，並先做不需Whisper或torchaudio的合成單音。12.1把440Hz、1600樣本、16000取樣率與振幅分開說清楚，圖示補上週期進度。12.2延續同一串樣本與同一個440Hz，把時長與取樣率連起來，再區別真的重新取樣和只改舊資料的時間標籤。因此我能跟著走到聲音入口，不需要猜前面的OCR實驗如何變成音訊模型。

transition_judgments.observation: The focus changes from paying for image positions to exposing weak sub-tasks. The repeated color/shape split gives the second question a concrete connection to the model discussed in the first.

After group-wise weaknesses, the opening explicitly says recognizing red circles does not imply reading digits. It defines OCR and builds the smallest visible label/pixel pair before mentioning a trained experiment.

11.12 promises to split the reported OCR mistakes; 11.13 does that with 1010 versus 1000, then returns to the same 30-image experiment. Character recognition becomes a string-level question without losing the earlier example.

This is a visible change from OCR scoring to describing a scene. The first paragraph supplies its own people/cup/table question, and the cited 11.4/10.2 material supplies the earlier question/position ideas. A reader can understand the new task without expecting the OCR model to become a natural-photo system.

The local-average example provides a concrete reason information can be lost before later computation; the next section uses the same eight-by-eight average idea for a thin stroke. The 未/末 story gives the new Chinese-text purpose before the deliberately simplified line example.

After asking whether strokes are still visible, the two-line notice asks whether visible characters are read in the right order. The cited 11.13 provides CER, and 11.16 repeats its definition before switching to the 臺/台 example.

The chapter opening explicitly connects picture features to sound features, states the different raw input, and announces the synthetic-tone sequence. It also states offline execution and no Whisper/torchaudio requirement, so the later pretrained-base discussion does not become an implicit new equipment requirement.
The promised synthetic tone becomes the actual tone(440.0) example; waveform, amplitude, frequency, shape, units, and the absence of recording/playback are explained around it.

12.1 finishes by promising how sample count relates to time; 12.2 opens with the same 1600 samples and 16000-per-second scale. The later distinction between recording a 440Hz source and relabeling an existing waveform prevents the two comparisons from becoming an unexplained example switch.

context_and_expectations.observation: The new helper functions are named at each snippet, and their input, returned report, relevant fields, and output meaning are described in nearby prose. The dictionary access pattern is already visible in the read 11.11/11.12 flow; 11.15 and 11.16 repeat the explanation where needed.

Toy digits, the 32×32 synthetic diagrams, Chinese notices, natural photos, and the later pretrained practical base remain distinguishable. The text states which small examples merely isolate a problem and does not force the reader to infer a shared trained model.

The basic demonstrations carry no hidden recording, playback, GPU, or later practical-model requirement in the read text. Chapter 12 explicitly states offline short examples and postpones real recordings.

validation_limits: This is a reading-continuity judgment. The reviewer did not execute snippets or check technical/numerical/empirical claims. Chapter 20 section bodies were deliberately not read; their new empirical content remains an unverified draft in this report.
